lessons_used: Predictions were generally overly optimistic, though certain new flows and compact layouts outperformed expectations.
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) was helpful in 3 winning tests, though specific placements hurt or showed no clear effect.
Sign-in copy tweaks (sign_in, copy), finish hints (finish, hint), and home hints (home, hint) showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Adding a new finish screen (finish, new_screen) hurt performance or showed no clear effect.
Home wait info changes (home, wait_info) were helpful in 1 winning test, while 3 tests showed no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin for any change kind tested only once, requiring at least 2 tests to state a rule.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Two-Column Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen into a two-column layout displaying the pet preview on one side and official details on the other.
candidates.why: Adoption drop-off is high (69.6% conversion, median 89s), indicating users spend significant time and drop out before finalizing their pet adoption.

guard.reason: Redesigning the adoption certificate layout while retaining pet and official details is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step has high drop-off, but redesigns consistently underperform (-3.1%).

candidates.title: Pick Friend Video Preview Audio Flow
candidates.change: Introduce a video and sound preview component flow on the pick friend screen to let users hear and see animated pet behaviors before adopting.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops conversion down to 69.6% and support received reports of users confused about pet behaviors after onboarding.

guard.reason: Adding video and audio preview components to the pick friend screen is permitted inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Supported by funnel and support reports; adoption new_flow has strong track record (+2.9%).

candidates.title: Choose Path Story Checklist Flow
candidates.change: Transform the story screen into an interactive checklist layout showing upcoming setup milestones.
candidates.why: choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s and 76.1% conversion, indicating initial confusion or hesitation at the start of onboarding.

guard.reason: Transforming the story screen into a setup milestone checklist removes its required job of introducing the pet.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Mascot Sound Progress Flow
candidates.change: Add a mascot component accompanied by audio feedback sound when background rendering completes on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: The home step (waiting screen) has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing drop-offs while waiting for background generation.

guard.reason: Adding mascot audio progress feedback to the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Addresses wait duration; new flows generally outperform expectations.

candidates.title: Sign In Desktop Access Progress Notification
candidates.change: Add step progress and notification indicator on the sign-in screen to clarify account authentication progress.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again, and 2 emails noted sign-in screen stalling.

guard.reason: Adding step progress indicators and ready notifications to the sign-in screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Strong support evidence, but notifications show modest positive lift overall.

candidates.title: Home Intro Companion Audio Greeting Incentive
candidates.change: Add a welcome mascot and interactive audio greeting badge on the home intro screen to celebrate setup completion.
candidates.why: Finish step drops conversion to 71.4% with median 395s / mean 5815s duration, showing users need positive reinforcement before entering the desktop pet view.

guard.reason: Adding a welcome mascot and badge component to the home intro overlay is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has high loss (28.6%) and incentive tests previously showed +2.5% lift.

candidates.title: Story Screen Step Counter Progress Display
candidates.change: Display step counter and remaining time estimate on the story screen to orient new users.
candidates.why: Choose path funnel shows a mean duration of 514s; setting clear expectations early helps reduce early drop-off.

guard.reason: Displaying a step counter and time estimate on the story screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Low implementation cost, but hints have shown no clear effect in past tests.

candidates.title: Upload Photos Mascot Visual Helper
candidates.change: Add a visual mascot helper with hint text on the photo upload screen to guide custom pet creation.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, and adoption conversion is lowest at 69.6%.

upload_photos.hint: Upload a clear, front-facing photo for the best desktop pet rendering.

guard.reason: Adding a mascot helper with photo guidelines to the upload photos screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: High impact step with support and funnel evidence, though hint changes yield small lift.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Progress Checklist Layout
candidates.change: Update the waiting screen layout to checklist format displaying background generation status items.
candidates.why: Home step waiting screen takes median 201s / mean 2336s, causing user drop-off due to lack of feedback during pet generation.

guard.reason: Using a checklist layout to show pet generation status retains the waiting screen's job.

candidates.score_note: Home step has lower drop-off and layout changes historically show negative relative lift.

candidates.title: Sign In Checklist Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Update the sign-in screen layout to checklist format showing account backup benefits.
candidates.why: 8 support emails cited pets missing or reset after re-login, so presenting account benefits clearly reduces confusion.

guard.reason: Updating the sign-in layout to a checklist displaying backup benefits is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Directly targets support emails, but layout updates tend to underperform.
